LanguageData.GF_IntroductionText:
Your colony understands xenogenetics and can now research biomass technology. Open the Research screen and select the GeneFoundry tab.

1. Biomass extraction unlocks the gene vat and basic extraction from meat, plants and organic corpses. Add bills at the vat and assign a cook. Cooking, Medicine and Intellectual skills affect extraction; larger, fresher corpses yield more biomass.

2. Enzymatic extraction unlocks herbal medicine recipes for improved recovery from all three sources. Corpse herbal medicine costs scale with body material.

3. Biomass refinement unlocks the refinery and hoppers. Place hoppers beside the refinery with their outlets facing it, store raw biomass in them, and add a refinement bill. Assign a qualified colonist to Research work to deliver neutroamine and prepare the batch. Automated processing then frees the operator.

Enzymatic extraction and refinement can be researched independently after extraction. Cleaner refinery rooms and skilled operators reduce failures; available gene processors reduce automated processing time. Extraction maximum speed, automated processing timing and refinery cleanliness effects can be adjusted in GeneFoundry's mod settings.

This introduction appears once per colony.
